problem.title: First Occurrence Using Recursive Binary Search
problem.problemStatement: Given a sorted array of integers that may contain duplicates and a target value, return the index of its first occurrence using recursion. If the target is not present, return -1.
problem.input: Integer n Sorted array nums Integer target
problem.output: The index of the first occurrence, or -1.
